name: AeroStream Scheduled Lakehouse Ingestion

on:
  schedule:
    # Runs automatically every 6 hours (at 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, 18:00 UTC)
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch: # Allows you to trigger it manually from your GitHub "Actions" tab!

jobs:
  run-pipeline:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    # 1. Checkout your code
    - name: Checkout Repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    # 2. Setup Python environment
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'

    # 3. Cache dependencies to speed up runs
    - name: Install Dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    # 4. Run the Ingestion script to pull live flights
    - name: Ingest Live Flights (Bronze & Silver)
      run: |
        python src/ingest.py

    # 5. Run dbt to materialize Gold analytics tables
    - name: Run dbt Transformations (Gold)
      run: |
        cd dbt_project
        pip install "mashumaro>=3.15" # ensure python 3.13 compatibility
        dbt run --profiles-dir .
        dbt test --profiles-dir .
        cd ..

    # 6. Push the updated database back to your repository
    - name: Commit and Push Database Update
      run: |
        git config --global user.name "AeroStream Automation Bot"
        git config --global user.email "bot@aerostream.io"
        git add data/lakehouse.db data/bronze/
        git commit -m "chrono: automated live flight ingestion and dbt compile [skip ci]" || echo "No changes to commit"
        git push origin main
